title: Origin story: Theseus
description: Theseus was the son of Aegeus, king of Athens, raised in Troezen until he could lift the boulder hiding his father's sword and sandals. Sailing to Crete as one of the tribute youths fed to the Minotaur, he won the love of Princess Ariadne, who gave him a ball of thread to find his way out of the labyrinth.

title: Stamina feats: Theseus
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought the Minotaur in darkness at the maze's center; Sailed home and forgot the sail-change, bearing his father's death.

title: Cultural impact: Theseus
